summary: The single Blueprint that serves every Melody token, present and future. Heart/Star/Swirl/Water are INSTANCE values, not subclasses. Do not author a per-variant Blueprint.

components.CollectionVolume: USphereComponent, radius 90, Pawn overlap only. Root.
components.TokenMesh: UStaticMeshComponent, /Game/EnvSandbox/SM_MelodyToken, scale 0.35. Material driven by VariantId.

exposed_instance_properties.name: VariantId
exposed_instance_properties.role: Token catalog variant key. Drives CurrencyId, Amount and material. This is the ONLY field a designer normally sets.

exposed_instance_properties.name: Element
exposed_instance_properties.role: Any currency id from the currency registry. Used directly when VariantId is unset or unresolvable. Named 'Element' because placed instances serialise it under that name.
exposed_instance_properties.note: NOT limited to the seven legacy elements. Golden, Mana, and currencies invented later are all placeable.

exposed_instance_properties.name: Amount
exposed_instance_properties.role: Quantity granted. Overridden by the catalog row's Value when VariantId resolves.

exposed_instance_properties.name: GrantId
exposed_instance_properties.role: Stable identity for durable idempotency. Auto-derived from the actor path when bAutoGenerateGrantId is true.

exposed_instance_properties.name: bAutoGenerateGrantId
exposed_instance_properties.role: Derive GrantId from level + actor name when unset, so a forgotten GrantId is not a silently dead pickup.

blueprint_owned_events.name: OnCollectedPresentation
blueprint_owned_events.role: VFX, SFX and collection flourish. Fires ONLY after the wallet accepts the grant, so a Blueprint can never celebrate a rejected transaction.
blueprint_owned_events.rule: C++ owns the transaction; the Blueprint owns the show.

binds.CurrencyContainer: UPanelWidget, BindWidgetOptional. Filled with one row per registry currency.

events.OnCurrencyRowsRebuilt: Receives UMelodiaCurrencyRegistry::GetSortedCurrencies() on every accepted transaction. Build one row per entry.

companion_widget.note: This widget binds NONE of the legacy TXT_* fields. That is why a currency added in data reaches the HUD with no UI work.

authority.wallet: UMelodiaTokenWalletSubsystem (Plugins/MelodiaCore) — sole balance authority. The pickup holds no balance state.

invariants: One Blueprint for all tokens. A per-variant child Blueprint is a defect, not a shortcut.
Collection is refused unless the resolved currency exists in the registry — a typo cannot mint currency.
A non-None GrantId already consumed is rejected, and that rejection survives a process restart.
The pickup disappears only after the wallet ACCEPTS the grant, never optimistically.
Adding a currency or a token variant is a data row plus a re-export. It is never a C++ change.

acceptance.data_driven_proof: Add a currency row WITHOUT recompiling, then in PIE run: melodia.Wallet.Grant <NewCurrency> 5 x. Acceptance proves currencies are genuinely data.
acceptance.idempotency_proof: melodia.Wallet.Grant Forte 5 test_id twice — the second must be REJECTED. Repeat across a full save/exit/relaunch/load cycle.
acceptance.universality_proof: Place two instances of BP_MelodyToken_Universal with VariantId heart and swirl. They must show different materials and grant Forte and Arcane respectively.

materialization.blocked_on: Editor session to create the two assets; all C++ seams and data mirrors are in place.
